from solution import big_sum
import pytest


def test_issue_example():
    """Example assert big_sum([1,2,3]) == 4."""
    assert big_sum([1, 2, 3]) == 4  # 1 + 3 = 4


def test_issue_descending_order():
    """Sum of the largest and smallest value regardless of order."""
    assert big_sum([9, 7, 5, 3]) == 12  # 3 + 9 = 12


def test_issue_two_elements():
    """Sum of the largest and smallest value in a two-element array."""
    assert big_sum([5, 10]) == 15  # 5 + 10 = 15


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Sum of the largest and smallest value in a single-element array."""
    assert big_sum([7]) == 14  # 7 + 7 = 14


def test_issue_all_equal():
    """Sum of the largest and smallest value when all values are equal."""
    assert big_sum([4, 4, 4, 4]) == 8  # 4 + 4 = 8


def test_issue_all_negative():
    """Sum of the largest and smallest value with all negative values."""
    assert big_sum([-5, -1, -3, -2]) == -6  # -5 + -1 = -6


def test_issue_mixed_sign_with_zero():
    """Sum of the largest and smallest value with mixed signs and zero."""
    assert big_sum([-10, 0, 10]) == 0  # -10 + 10 = 0


def test_issue_duplicates_and_zero():
    """Sum of the largest and smallest value with duplicates and zero."""
    assert big_sum([0, 2, 0, 5, 3]) == 5  # 0 + 5 = 5


def test_contract_implements_function():
    """Implement big_sum(nums) in solution.py."""
    assert callable(big_sum)


def test_contract_takes_single_argument():
    """Public interface def big_sum(nums) takes one argument."""
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        big_sum()
